year6Ordering.ownerRule: The final browser-visible Year 6 list must be chronological by visible display code.
year6Ordering.lessons: Y6TnMm sorts by term n then lesson m.

historicalProvenFix.mechanism: post-render visible-code DOM reorder plus MutationObserver and cache-bust

year6Ordering.currentV2Mechanism: Numeric pre-render sort plus the exact September-style standalone, cache-busted visible-code DOM guard loaded before the V2 module; the guard uses MutationObserver so later DOM changes are corrected.

standaloneGuard.reason: This preserves the same independent last-mile architecture that actually worked in September instead of relying on the V2 application bundle to enforce the browser-visible order.

preservation.rule: Future frontend rebuilds must start from this source branch or a descendant, must load the standalone Year 6 ordering guard from index.html with an explicit cache-busting version, and must retain the exact owner-failure regression.
